name: os-development-kernel-shell
description: OS Development (Linux Kernel & Shell): kernel architecture and programming in C and Rust, modules and drivers, kernel concurrency, syscalls and the userspace ABI, eBPF and sched_ext, boot and init, systemd/cgroups/containers, the kernel development process, debugging and tracing (ftrace, perf, KASAN, crash dumps), security and hardening, plus the shell layer — POSIX sh/bash/zsh/fish/nushell semantics and their traps, choosing a shell, defensive scripting, and the coreutils/systemd userland.
